exposure: Institute of Medicine (IOM) recommendations about gestational weight gain
Weight gain above vs. within IOM recommendations in the second and third trimesters
finding: Weight gain above IOM recommendations during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of HDP, caesarean delivery, macrosomia, LGA, and neonatal hypoglycemia.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery rates were higher in women with weight gain above IOM recommendations.
